channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 01
item.description:
49 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Radwater‑powered sprinklers now emit 1.5× more radiation (effectively doubling output).
  • Burstcloth chains can be attached to any bone, allowing chain connections at either end for builds.
  • Crossbow and other bows now display the arrowhead during reload, syncing visual with actual shot.

Vehicles

  • Attack heli frame colliders fixed, preventing unintended damage to players.

Radiation & Environment

  • Radwater‑powered sprinklers now emit 1.5× more radiation (effectively doubling output).

Monuments & NPCs

  • Monument blockers added to Underwater Labs red‑key‑card doors, blocking entry without the proper key.
  • Underwater Labs NPC spawner moved slightly away from the new monument blocker.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Settings menu dropdown text now updates dynamically and matches UI colors.

Building & Physics

  • Loot crate gib colliders resized, reducing crate physics glitches and stuck crates.
  • Burstcloth chains can be attached to any bone, allowing chain connections at either end for builds.
  • Crossbow and other bows now display the arrowhead during reload, syncing visual with actual shot.

Items & Storage

  • Thread‑race fix in DisplayBoxStorage saving prevents possible item loss during saves.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 31
item.description:
47 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Large rig monument blocker collision fixed and missing vent cages added to monuments.
  • Beach area added to water pipe topology, expanding pipe placement options near coastlines.

Base Building

  • Pipe access improved: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.

Gameplay Bugs

  • Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.

Animals & Farming

  • New shearing interaction lets players shear livestock for resources.

Deployables

  • Carvable pumpkin deployment improved for more reliable placement.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Footstep sounds now play correctly when heavily armored or wearing diving fins, restoring audio feedback while moving.

UI & Quality of Life

  • High-Quality Metal collectable now displays its proper name token, fixing missing label issues.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 30
item.description:
12 development commits

Audio & Communication

  • Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

Gameplay & Balance

  • Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.
